name: Fantasy Valley
source:
David has been trapped on his family's farm his whole life. When his parents suddenly leave the valley, everything changes. David must move into town and... go to college! The story follows the day to day life of David as he embarks upon his adult independence. He will pursue his studies, chase beautiful women, and maybe even save the valley!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/ancho]Patreon[/url]]
